competences.item1_text: Roads, intersections, driveways, pavements and cycle paths.

process.title: A clear process from analysis to construction support.
process.step1_text: We identify the investment scope, site conditions, and formal and technical requirements.
process.step2_text: We develop solutions consistent with investor requirements and construction realities.
process.step3_text: We coordinate documentation with disciplines, network operators and road administrators.
process.step4_text: We assist with approvals, changes and the construction phase.

wspolpraca_page.hero_text: We deliver comprehensive road infrastructure design, covering roads and streets as well as sanitary and telecommunications networks. We create functional, safe and cost-effective solutions tailored to the needs of investors and users.
wspolpraca_page.partner_text: We provide comprehensive support at every stage of an investment — from concept through construction documentation to multidisciplinary coordination — tailored to the project's requirements and delivery process.
wspolpraca_page.expertise_title: Road infrastructure is what we know best.
wspolpraca_page.expertise1_text: Functional and safe road solutions tailored to context.
wspolpraca_page.expertise2_text: Traffic engineering and safety analysis for better outcomes.
wspolpraca_page.expertise3_text: Accurate 2D/3D documentation and coordinated digital models.
wspolpraca_page.cta_title: Looking for a road design partner?
wspolpraca_page.cta_text: Tell us about your project, its location and the scope of support you need. We'll define the right cooperation model for your team.
